query: BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='8s'; SET LOCAL lock_timeout='3s'; WITH pages AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT task_id,page_no,body_sha256,record_count,source_bytes,committed_at FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_pages_v2 WHERE run_id='fixed3000-20250901-20260731-v1-20261030' ORDER BY task_id,page_no LIMIT 10001), progress AS (SELECT count(*) page_rows,max(p.committed_at) latest_page_commit,sum(p.record_count) physical_records_or_pointers,sum(p.source_bytes) source_bytes,count(b.task_id) readbacks,count(*) FILTER(WHERE b.task_id IS NULL) missing_readbacks,count(*) FILTER(WHERE b.task_id IS NOT NULL AND (p.body_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM b.body_sha256 OR p.body_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM b.readback_sha256 OR p.record_count IS DISTINCT FROM b.expected_records OR p.record_count IS DISTINCT FROM b.actual_records)) mismatches FROM pages p LEFT JOIN astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_readbacks_v2 b ON b.task_id=p.task_id AND b.page_no=p.page_no), examples AS (SELECT q.id,q.family,q.kind,q.provider,q.status,q.run_fence,q.next_retry_at,q.page_attempts,cardinality(q.dependencies) dependency_count,r.status='ACTIVE' AND q.run_fence=r.fence AND q.status='PENDING' AND q.next_retry_at<=clock_timestamp() AND q.page_attempts<8 AND cardinality(q.dependencies)=0 AND q.kind IN('alpaca_reference','massive_short_interest') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_provider_dependencies_v2 d WHERE d.run_id=q.run_id AND d.provider=q.provider AND d.state='BLOCKED_EXTERNAL') AS durable_filters_ready_for_last_advertised_supported_kind FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 q JOIN astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_runs_v2 r ON r.id=q.run_id WHERE q.run_id='fixed3000-20250901-20260731-v1-20261030' AND q.id IN('backfill-plan-450ab7067dd33e59efe29fec68b60b0af2ea6851c15817520fa768733d501309','backfill-plan-0af20ca7c2a4e3ca2061f6e6650f5fdea339327d3dd108e454ca38587d003963')) SELECT clock_timestamp() observed_at,to_jsonb(p) progress,p.page_rows<10001 AS bounded_page_population_complete,(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY id) FROM examples e) existing_runnable_examples FROM progress p; COMMIT;
